response.sql:
WITH station_counts AS (
  SELECT
    o.observstation,
    COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count
  FROM observatories AS o
  LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t
    ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation
), shares AS (
  SELECT
    observstation,
    telescope_count,
    telescope_count::numeric / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes), 0) AS share
  FROM station_counts
), scored AS (
  SELECT
    observstation,
    telescope_count,
    share,
    share - AVG(share) OVER () AS above_average
  FROM shares
), eligible AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM scored
  WHERE above_average > 0
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY above_average DESC) AS share_rank
  FROM eligible
)
SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, above_average
FROM ranked
WHERE share_rank <= 10
ORDER BY above_average DESC;

assumptions.assumption: The average share is the unweighted arithmetic mean across every row in observatories, including stations with zero telescopes; stations with zero telescopes are included in the counts.
